_doc: FluentBoards vendor-map per PRINCIPLES-VENDOR.md V11. One row per touched ability. Populated incrementally as fix packages land. Drift detector, not a perfect proof.

abilities.direct_storage_rationale: Vendor exposes no public delete-board service or REST handler; FluentBoards admin UI builds the same cascade in JS. Pre-existing Phase B decision; Package 2 only addresses the V5 Collection coercion at the array_map sites in the cascade.
abilities.notes: Package 2 V5 fix: array_map on the wpFluent Collection result raised PHP TypeError. Registrar now coerces via fluent_abilities_to_array() before array_map (1 of 11 P-A sites).

abilities.direct_storage_rationale: Same as delete-board — direct table cascade; no documented vendor service for task deletion in the installed source.
abilities.notes: Package 2 V5 fix: subtask-id Collection coerced via fluent_abilities_to_array() before array_map (2 of 11 P-A sites).

abilities.pattern: P-B oneOf — RECLASSIFIED/escalated (dispatch premise contradicted by installed handler)
abilities.notes: Package 5 STOP/escalate: dispatch prescribed oneOf('exactly one; both rejected') but installed handler (abilities-discovery.php) uses if(attachment_id) elseif(url) precedence — BOTH accepted (attachment_id wins), only neither-resolvable rejected. NOT self-elected; truthful constraint is at-least-one (anyOf), a schema change on a contradicted premise — bounced to reviewer. No code change in P5. see docs/P5-SCHEMA-CLARITY.md
